brand.name: ReturnLoop
brand.audience: retail marketers and loyalty leads at mid-market brands

turns.user_message: We're launching ReturnLoop, a loyalty platform for mid-market retail brands. Budget is $48k, timeline is 5 weeks, and the goal is demos from retention marketers. What do you need to know before we start?
expected_behaviors: Asks about the buyer, proof points, and objectives
autofail_triggers: Moves into tactics before understanding the brief

rubric_criteria.description: Uses clarifying questions to understand the launch brief

scoring_guide.3: Questions surface buyer context, proof points, and goals
scoring_guide.0: Moves into tactics without understanding the brief

turns.user_message: Good questions. Our differentiator is that we show actual repeat-purchase behavior and drop-off timing, not survey-based customer sentiment. What insights should shape the campaign?

rubric_criteria.description: Depth and specificity of audience insight

scoring_guide.3: Insight reflects a specific retention tension

rubric_criteria.description: Positioning ladders from the chosen insight
